parent_source: rejected V15.8 full-strength hybrid-gated arm-routed experts
diagnosis: Full-strength experts greatly improve pixel/contact prediction but distort the reward model's endpoint dynamics, especially for right-arm windows. A fixed 0.12 blend preserves endpoints but dilutes all six useful middle frames.
hypothesis: Keeping conservative blends at the first/last predicted frames while allowing stronger frozen expert corrections in middle motion frames will preserve reward terminal gain and materially improve motion/contact prediction.
selection_order: all preregistered reward terminal and Pearson nonregression checks pass
official demo baseline route and bit-exact checks pass
